Team —

We need to kick off a focused negotiation sprint for our customer support stack renewals (Zendesk, Intercom) and the Gainsight renewal/PS conversation. Renewal windows start mid-June for Zendesk and Intercom; Gainsight PS/contract is up in July.

Attachments: Renewal_MAPlan_20260517.docx (draft mutual action plan), Usage_Dashboard_May2026.png

High-level asks:
- Reduce annual seat/license run-rate for Zendesk by at least 20% or get equivalent credits for unused seats.
- Hold Intercom pricing flat but secure API/throughput SLAs and lower message costs for automated workflows.

Please review the MA plan and the usage snapshot. I want to align on negotiation levers by Tuesday EOD so we can issue vendor outreach Wednesday morning.

Sofia

Sofia —

Thanks, saw the MA plan. Two quick data points to inform levers:
- Zendesk: active agents average 120/day; seat utilization is skewed (20 "power" agents, 80 light users). We could negotiate seat-tiering and move 60 light users to a shared pool.
- Intercom: conversation volume up 45% YoY but bot-handled messages are ~38% — that’s where we can push for lower message tiers for bot/API calls.

Proposal: run two parallel tracks — (A) cost-shift negotiation with Zendesk (seat-tiering + credits); (B) capability negotiations with Intercom (throughput, API cost caps, event-based billing). Meanwhile pilot Gainsight PS focused on CSM workflow automation before committing to full rollout.

I’ll pull a short usage extract and a cost model to hand to the vendors.

-r
